# Prior Authorization Policy: Total Knee Arthroplasty (CPT 27447)

## Policy Overview

Prior authorization is required for total knee arthroplasty (CPT 27447).
All three criteria below must be met for approval.

## Required Criteria

### C1: Diagnosis of severe knee osteoarthritis

Patient must have a documented diagnosis of severe knee osteoarthritis,
Kellgren-Lawrence Grade III or IV, confirmed on standing weight-bearing
radiographs of the affected knee.

### C2: Failure of conservative management for at least 6 months

Patient must have documented failure of conservative management for a minimum
of 6 consecutive months, including physician-supervised physical therapy and
anti-inflammatory medication. Documentation must specify treatment duration
and clinical outcome.

### C3: BMI less than 40 at time of surgical evaluation

Patient body mass index (BMI) must be documented as less than 40 kg/m2 at
the time of the pre-surgical evaluation. Morbid obesity (BMI >= 40) is a
relative contraindication and requires case-by-case review.

## Documentation Requirements

# Medical Policy: Rotator Cuff Repair (CPT 29827)

Effective: 2026-01-01 · Payer: Acme Health Plan · Policy ID: SURG-041

## Prior Authorization Criteria

Arthroscopic rotator cuff repair (CPT 29827) is considered medically necessary
when ALL of the following criteria are met:

1. Full-thickness rotator cuff tear confirmed by MRI or MR arthrogram of the
   affected shoulder.

2. Failure of at least 3 months of conservative management, which must include
   physician-supervised physical therapy. Documentation must include treating
   provider, treatment dates, and clinical outcome demonstrating lack of adequate
   improvement.

3. Documented functional impairment affecting activities of daily living, as
   evidenced by a formal functional assessment, shoulder disability questionnaire,
   or equivalent standardized instrument with scoring.

## Exclusions

- Partial-thickness tears not meeting full-thickness criteria on imaging.
- Conservative management period of less than 3 months unless the tear is
  acute traumatic in nature.

## Documentation Requirements

# Prior Authorization Policy: Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43644)

## Policy Overview

Prior authorization is required for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy
(CPT 43644). All three criteria below must be met for approval.

## Required Criteria

### C1: BMI threshold

Patient must have a documented body mass index (BMI) of 40 kg/m2 or greater,
OR a documented BMI of 35 kg/m2 or greater with at least one obesity-related
comorbidity. Qualifying comorbidities include: Type 2 diabetes mellitus,
hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea, or clinically significant
cardiovascular disease.

### C2: Physician-supervised diet program

Patient must have documented completion of a physician-supervised, structured
diet and lifestyle modification program for a minimum of 6 consecutive months.
The program must be supervised by a licensed physician or registered dietitian
operating under physician oversight. Self-directed weight loss attempts do not
satisfy this requirement. Documentation must include program start and end
dates, attendance or visit records, and a clinical summary from the supervising
provider.

### C3: Psychiatric or psychological evaluation

# Prior Authorization Policy: MRI Lumbar Spine without Contrast (CPT 72148)

## Policy Overview

Prior authorization is required for MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast
(CPT 72148) for non-emergent indications. All three criteria below must be
met for approval. Red-flag findings (see C3) permit immediate imaging without
prior authorization.

## Required Criteria

### C1: Duration of low back pain symptoms

Patient must have documented low back pain symptoms for a minimum of 6
consecutive weeks. Documentation must include symptom onset date or a
clinical note confirming symptom duration of at least 6 weeks.

### C2: Failure of conservative management

Patient must have documented failure of a course of conservative management,
including physician-supervised physical therapy administered for a minimum
of 6 weeks. Documentation must include the treating provider, treatment dates,
and clinical outcome demonstrating lack of adequate improvement.

### C3: Absence of red-flag findings

requirement. Documentation must include program start and end
dates, attendance or visit records, and a clinical summary from the supervising
provider.

### C3: Psychiatric or psychological evaluation

Patient must have completed a formal psychiatric or psychological evaluation
within 12 months prior to the authorization request. The evaluation must
include documented clearance for bariatric surgery, confirming the absence
of active psychiatric contraindications.

# Medical Policy: Knee Arthroscopy with Meniscectomy (CPT 29881)

Effective: 2026-01-01 · Payer: Acme Health Plan · Policy ID: SURG-029

## Prior Authorization Criteria

Knee arthroscopy with medial OR lateral meniscectomy (CPT 29881) is considered
medically necessary when ALL of the following criteria are met:

1. Documented meniscal tear confirmed by MRI or prior arthroscopy.
2. Presence of mechanical symptoms (locking, catching, giving way) OR joint-line
   pain with a positive McMurray test.
3. Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative therapy, including at least one of:
   physical therapy, NSAIDs, activity modification, or intra-articular injection.
4. Absence of advanced osteoarthritis in the affected compartment
   (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4).

## Exclusions

- Asymptomatic incidental meniscal tears found on imaging.
- Primary treatment of osteoarthritis pain without discrete tear.

## Documentation Requirements
